kai: FYI — found a subtle typing regression in the edge starter sample. Generic inference collapses to `any` after the edge bundle step. Only hits when sample is built for edge runtime.
rachel: repl? bundle/logs? is it our typings or the bundler?
kai: minimal repro below. works in node builds but becomes `any` once SWC/esbuild runs for edge.

```ts
// packages/sdk/src/surface.ts
export type Opt<T = unknown> = { meta?: T }
export function make<T>(opt: Opt<T>): { get: () => T }
export function make(opt: Opt<any>) { return { get: () => (opt.meta as any) } }

// app/index.ts
const x = make({ meta: { uid: 10 } })
// expect x.get() -> { uid: number } but consumer types become `any` after edge bundle
```

omar: sounds like the implementation signature leaked into the published .d.ts. We ship ESM+CJS + types; bundlers + `moduleResolution: bundler` can cause TS to pick up the wrong declaration file or prefer the impl signature.
nora: can we just change public defaults to `unknown`? that helps but impl signature still exists.

typebot: issue created: DX-4812 — "edge bundle widens generic overload to any in starter sample" (assignee: @omar).

omar: plan:
- add a tiny typing smoke test in `examples/ci/edge-typing.ts` that runs `tsc --noEmit` against the packaged example
- change emitted d.ts to only expose `declare` overloads (no exported impl sig) by marking impl `/** @internal */` and enabling `stripInternal` in declaration build
- short-term: adjust example tsconfig to `moduleResolution: node16` and note it in README as a mitigation

rachel: i can help with the `d.ts` surgery. prefer not to force consumers to use wrapper types.

kai: another defensive option: add an exported helper `narrowMeta<T>(m: Opt<T>): Opt<T>` that consumers can call to assert generics when inference fails. low friction fallback.

nora: add a CI check to build the examples with both `moduleResolution: bundler` and `node16` to catch regressions.

omar: i'll open a PR with the d.ts changes + test tomorrow and link DX-4812. will include the minimal repro and a diff of published declarations.

kai: thanks — holding the starter PR until the typings PR lands so onboarding doesn't regress. :thumbsup: 

typebot: linked PR #1401 -> DX-4812 (in review).

omar: PR merged, tests added, readme updated. re-open DX-4812 if you still hit it. :rocket:
